scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flownexus/shared && concurrently -n client,server,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @flownexus/client" "npm run dev -w @flownexus/server" "npm run dev -w @flownexus/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flownexus/shared && npm run build -w @flownexus/server && npm run build -w @flownexus/worker && npm run build -w @flownexus/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flownexus/shared && npm run test -w @flownexus/server && npm run test -w @flownexus/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flownexus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flownexus/server && npm run typecheck -w @flownexus/worker && npm run typecheck -w @flownexus/client
